上午较早时段避开团队游客，晴间多云或海浪适中的下午适合拍摄岛屿层次。: Early morning hours to avoid tour groups; sunny-to-cloudy or moderate wave afternoons are suitable for shooting island layers.
上午进入普拉多大道与丽池历史景观区域，下午拍摄阿方索十二世纪念建筑、大池倒影及季: Enter the historical landscape area of Paseo del Prado and El Retiro in the morning, and photograph the monument to Alfonso XII, the grand pond reflection, and seasonal trees in the afternoon.
上午适合拍海湾清透蓝色，下午斜光使城区和沙滩产生立体层次。: Morning is suitable for shooting the bay's crystal-clear blue, and afternoon oblique light creates three-dimensional layers on the town and beach.
上午首场避开游客，或下午斜阳在烟囱与波浪屋面之间形成强烈阴影时拍摄。: Shoot during the first morning opening slots or when afternoon slanting light forms strong shadows between the chimneys and undulating roofs.
上午首批开放时段或接近日落的开放时段。: First morning opening slots or opening slots close to sunset.
上午首批开放时段，4月及10月气温适宜。: First morning opening slots, with pleasant temperatures in April and October.
上午首批开放时段，晴朗冬日适合观察远山。: First morning opening slots, with clear winter days suitable for observing distant mountains.
上午首批渡船时段，或下午云层散开后。: First morning ferry slots, or after afternoon clouds disperse.
上午首批班次；1月下旬至2月下旬可沿线观察杏花物候。: First morning departures; almond blossom phenology can be observed along the route from late January to late February.
上午首批预约时段，或傍晚拍摄王宫外围。: First morning reservation slots, or evening photography of the Royal Palace outskirts.
上午首班船登岛，或下午光线转暖时。: Take the first morning boat to the island, or when light warms up in the afternoon.
上湖钙华群瀑与Kozjak镜湖: Upper lake travertine waterfall group and Kozjak mirror lake
下午15:00后，峡谷西侧岩壁与桥身出现立体阴影。: After 15:00 in the afternoon, three-dimensional shadows appear on the canyon's western rock walls and bridge body.
下午侧光或适度涌浪时段，前提是广场开放且当地没有危险海浪警报。: Afternoon side-light or moderate swell time slots, provided the plaza is open and there are no dangerous wave warnings locally.
下午至日落前90分钟，西侧低角度光线照亮新桥外墙。: From the afternoon to 90 minutes before sunset, low-angle light from the west illuminates the outer walls of the New Bridge.
下午至日落前，或1–2月偶遇降雪后的晴朗上午。: From afternoon to sunset, or clear mornings after occasional snowfall in January–February.
下午至日落前，西侧湖岸有机会获得照亮纪念建筑正面的光线。: From afternoon to sunset, western lake shores offer opportunities to get light illuminating the front of commemorative structures.
下午至日落前，西向光线照亮玄武岩断面。: From afternoon to sunset, west-facing light illuminates the basalt sections.
下湖石灰岩峡谷与78米大瀑布: Lower lake limestone canyon and 78-meter grand waterfall

不必购买修道院内部门票也可在开放的外围区域取景。相比桥口草坡，高位平台更容易纳入: Framing can be done in open outer areas without purchasing tickets inside the monastery. Compared to the grassy slope at the bridgehead, high viewing platforms make it easier to incorporate the bridge arch and city panorama; retreat to public viewing areas when the site is closed.
不要把Generalife安排在纳斯里德宫殿预约前的紧张时段；两处景点之间距离不: Do not schedule Generalife in a tight time slot before your Nasrid Palaces reservation; the distance between the two attractions is quite far, and it is recommended to reserve at least 45 minutes of flexible time.
不要踩入湿润瀑布岩面。坐标位于接近格林尼治零度经线的瀑布地物节点，实际拍摄应选择: Do not step onto the wet waterfall rock face. The coordinates are located at the waterfall feature node near the Greenwich Prime Meridian, and actual shooting should choose the safe viewing route along GR-11.
不要驾车进入最窄历史街巷。上午先拍完整岩棚，再用中焦截取巨岩与窗户之间的尺度关系: Do not drive into the narrowest historic alleys. Shoot the complete rock overhang first in the morning, and then use a medium telephoto lens to capture the scale relationship between the giant rock and the windows.

两岛租车燃油、岛际航班、徒步预约及季节性接驳: Two-island car rental fuel, inter-island flights, hiking reservations, and seasonal transfers

两片高耸灰白岩壁构成天然狭缝，内部透明浅海呈蓝绿色，白色卵石滩在封闭岩壁之间形成: Two towering gray-white rock walls form a natural narrow crevice, with transparent shallow seas inside showing blue-green colors, and white pebble beaches forming a bright visual focal point between the enclosed rock walls.
中世纪环城墙与双海堡: Medieval circular city wall and twin sea fortresses

中焦镜头、偏振镜、保暖防雨外套。: Medium telephoto lens, polarizing filter, warm waterproof jacket.
中长焦、广角、保暖层和防滑徒步鞋。: Medium-telephoto, wide-angle, thermal layer, and anti-slip hiking shoes.

乘 V19 公交至附近站点后沿 Carrer de Marià Labèrnia: Take V19 bus to the nearby stop, then walk uphill along Carrer de Marià Labèrnia for about 10–20 minutes, or hike from Park Güell for about 30–40 minutes.
乘Avant列车抵达托莱多，参观哥特式大教堂及历史石巷，日落前前往Mirador: Take the Avant train to Toledo, visit the Gothic cathedral and historic stone alleys, head to Mirador del Valle before sunset, and choose to stay overnight in the old town.
乘公交或按规定前往马斯卡村观景。持专项预约者可将全天用于峡谷徒步；普通观景游客下: Take the bus or head to Masca viewpoint as regulated. Those with special reservations can spend the whole day on canyon hiking; regular sightseeing tourists head to Archipenque in the afternoon to photograph the sea cliff sunset.
乘地铁2号线至Retiro站，进入世界遗产历史园林后沿主路步行约8–12分钟至M: Take Metro Line 2 to Retiro station, enter the UNESCO World Heritage historic park and walk along the main path for about 8–12 minutes to the Monument to Alfonso XII.
乘地铁3号线或10号线至Plaza de España站，步行约10–15分钟至: Take Metro Line 3 or Line 10 to Plaza de España station, and walk about 10–15 minutes to the outer perimeter of the temple.
乘地铁D线至São Bento站，步行约2分钟进入铁路车站主大厅。: Take Metro Line D to São Bento station, and walk about 2 minutes into the railway station's main concourse.
乘授权四驱出租车抵达湖区，先拍 Els Encantats 双峰倒影，再徒步经过: Take an authorized 4x4 taxi to the lake district, first capture the reflection of the Els Encantats twin peaks, then hike past the Ratera waterfall and lakes, ascend to the Lake Sant Maurici panoramic viewpoint, and return.
乘早班杜罗线火车前往Pinhão，拍摄车站瓷砖，预约当地酒庄参观并入住河谷。: Take the early morning Douro Line train to Pinhão, photograph the station's tilework, book a local winery visit, and check into the valley.
乘缆车抵达后可沿山脊移动寻找无遮挡视角，避免只停留在上站出口。使用 70–200: After arriving by cable car, you can move along the ridge to find unobstructed angles, avoiding staying only at the upper station exit. Use a 70–200mm lens to emphasize the spatial relationship among the river, museum, and valley.
乘里斯本28E电车至Largo das Portas do Sol站，或从San: Take Lisbon Tram 28E to Largo das Portas do Sol station, or walk uphill from Santa Apolónia metro station for about 20 minutes.
乘首批允许进入的接驳车抵达 Pradera de Ordesa，沿 GR-11: Take the first permitted shuttle bus to Pradera de Ordesa, follow the GR-11 trail to photograph successively the Estrecho Waterfall, Soaso Staircase Waterfall, and Tail of the Horse Waterfall, and return via the same route, totaling about 17–18 km.
乘首班渡船登岛，徒步Fort Royal观景区，沿开放海岸步道游览，乘末班船之前: Take the first ferry to the island, hike the Fort Royal viewpoint area, stroll along the open coastal trail, and return before the last ferry.
乘马德里地铁2号线、5号线或R支线至Ópera站，步行约5–8分钟至王宫参观入口: Take Madrid Metro Line 2, Line 5, or Branch Line R to Ópera station, and walk about 5–8 minutes to the Royal Palace visitor entrance.
云海之上与宝石色火山口湖: Above the sea of clouds and gem-toned crater lakes
五星级海岸度假酒店或高端火山风格精品酒店4晚: 4 nights at a 5-star coastal resort or high-end volcanic boutique hotel
仅在天气稳定、无危险积雪且步道开放时登上卡尔西拉鲁埃戈观景台。体能充足者可按管理: Only ascend the Candelaria Ruego viewpoint when weather conditions are stable, there is no hazardous snow accumulation, and the trail is open. Visitors with sufficient stamina may complete the Faja de Pelay loop according to management regulations; otherwise, choose a suitable open route to return.
从 Arrecife 沿 LZ-1 前往 Tahíche，按 Fundación: From Arrecife, take LZ-1 towards Tahíche, follow the Fundación César Manrique signs into the museum parking area near Jorge Luis Borges Street (about a 10–15 minute drive).
从 Arrecife 沿 LZ-1 向北至 Guatiza，再按景区指示进入停车: From Arrecife, take LZ-1 north to Guatiza, then follow scenic area signs into the parking lot (about a 20–25 minute drive).
从 Arrecife 沿 LZ-1 向北行驶约30–40分钟，进入 Jameos: From Arrecife, drive north along LZ-1 for about 30–40 minutes, enter the Jameos del Agua parking lot, and descend the scenic area stairs into the interior of the volcanic tunnel.
从 Cruz del Carmen 沿 TF-12 继续行驶，转 TF-114: From Cruz del Carmen, continue driving along TF-12, turn onto the TF-114 branch road for about 10–15 minutes to reach the viewpoint, park, and walk a few minutes.
从 Deià 村沿 Ma-10 转入海湾支路，自驾约10分钟；停车位不足时沿村庄: From Deià village, take the Ma-10 and turn onto the cove branch road (about a 10-minute drive); when parking is limited, walking from the village to the cove takes about 30–40 minutes.
从 Haría 沿 LZ-201 前往 Yé，再转 LZ-202 抵达北端悬崖观: From Haría, take LZ-201 towards Yé, then transfer to LZ-202 to reach the northern cliff viewpoint architecture (about a 20–30 minute drive).
从 Jameos del Agua 经连接道路前往景区，车程约5–10分钟；参加: From Jameos del Agua, take the connecting road to the scenic area (about a 5–10 minute drive); join the official guided cave tour lasting about 50 minutes and covering approximately 1 kilometer.
从 Ma-10 山脉公路转入 Ma-2141，至领带结弯道附近合法停车区域；从索: From the Ma-10 mountain highway, turn onto the Ma-2141 and head to the legally designated parking area near the tie-knot curve; about 60–80 minutes from Sóller.
从 Playa Blanca 前往 Los Ajaches 保护区，在合规道路与: From Playa Blanca, head to the Los Ajaches Reserve, photograph the Papagayo coves within compliant roads and trails, go snorkeling or rest onshore in the afternoon depending on sea conditions, and capture the cape silhouettes at dusk.
从 Playa Blanca 沿当地道路进入 Los Ajaches 保护区，经: From Playa Blanca, take local roads into the Los Ajaches Reserve, drive along about 6–7 km of unpaved road to the Papagayo parking area, and then walk along the open trail to the cape.
从 Plaza del Funicular 搭乘 Artxanda 登山缆车约: Take the Artxanda Funicular from Plaza del Funicular (about 3 minutes), and upon reaching the upper station, follow the mountaintop trail to find the marked viewpoints.
从 Pradera de Ordesa 沿 GR-11 穿越山毛榉林及瀑布带，单: From Pradera de Ordesa, follow the GR-11 through the beech forest and waterfall zone, a one-way hike of about 2–2.5 hours.
从 Pradera de Ordesa 沿 GR-11 经典谷底步道前行约 1–: From Pradera de Ordesa, follow the classic GR-11 valley-bottom trail for about 1–1.5 hours, and turn onto the viewpoint branch path following the Cascada del Estrecho sign.
从 Pradera de Ordesa 沿 GR-11 经典谷底路线徒步约8.5: From Pradera de Ordesa, hike along the classic GR-11 valley-bottom route for about 8.5–9 km (approx. 3 hours one way, 6 hours round trip, excluding photography stops).
从 San Cristóbal de La Laguna 沿 TF-12 行驶约: From San Cristóbal de La Laguna, drive along the TF-12 for about 25–35 minutes to the visitor center, enter the Sendero de los Sentidos (Sensory Trail)—the short route takes about 10–20 minutes, while the longer loop takes about 30–45 minutes.
从 Santanyí 经 Ma-6100 方向驶往 Cala Llombards: From Santanyí, take the Ma-6100 towards Cala Llombards, park in the designated public lot, and walk along the permitted access route for about 25–35 minutes, featuring steep rocks in the final section.
从 Santiago del Teide 沿 TF-436 行驶约20分钟，或乘: From Santiago del Teide, drive along the TF-436 for about 20 minutes, or take the TITSA Route 355 bus to Masca village, and walk to the village public viewing area.
从 Tamaimo 沿 TF-454 向 Puerto de Santiago: From Tamaimo, drive along the TF-454 toward Puerto de Santiago for about 15–20 minutes to reach the roadside public viewpoint; you can continue to the Port of Los Gigantes for a boat cruise.
从 Yaiza 或 Mancha Blanca 沿 LZ-67 抵达 Monta: From Yaiza or Mancha Blanca, take the LZ-67 to the Montañas del Fuego management entrance, enter Islote de Hilario, and transfer to the scenic area's dedicated bus to complete the roughly 14 km volcanic route.
从 Yaiza 沿 LZ-704 前往 El Golfo 村，在指定停车区停车，: From Yaiza, take the LZ-704 to El Golfo village, park in the designated area, and then walk along the official open trail for about 5–10 minutes to the northern viewpoint.
从Azoguejo广场穿过老城主街、Plaza Mayor及大教堂区域，徒步约2: From Azoguejo Square, walk through the old town's main street, Plaza Mayor, and the cathedral area for about 25–35 minutes to reach the castle entrance.
从Benagil沿地方道路自驾约5–10分钟，在Carvalho停车区步行，经人: Drive from Benagil along local roads for about 5–10 minutes, park at the Carvalho parking area, and descend to the beach via an artificial rock tunnel and stairs.
从Carvoeiro镇中心沿Carvoeiro Boardwalk木栈道步行约1: From the center of Carvoeiro town, walk along the Carvoeiro Boardwalk for about 15–20 minutes, following the signs into the Algar Seco open area.
从Cuevas del Sol沿公共道路跨过河道，步行约3–5分钟进入阴影街。: From Cuevas del Sol, cross the river via public roads and walk for about 3–5 minutes to enter Calle de la Sombra.
从D1公路旁Entrance 1入园，沿官方A线或B线下降至峡谷底部，步行约20: Enter the park from Entrance 1 next to the D1 highway, descend along the official Line A or Line B to the canyon floor, and walk for about 20–35 minutes.
从Entrance 1沿下湖步道向上游行进约60–90分钟，或从P3码头沿正式步: From Entrance 1, head upstream along the Lower Lakes trail for about 60–90 minutes, or return via the official trail from the P3 pier.
从Entrance 1首批入园，拍摄大瀑布、Sastavci高处全景、Šuplj: Enter the park first thing in the morning from Entrance 1 to photograph the Great Waterfall, the panoramic view from high points at Sastavci, the area near Šupljara Cave, and Lake Novakovića Brod (Milanovac Lake).
从Entrance 2乘短程电动船至P2，沿官方E线进入上湖瀑布群，步行约40–: Take the short electric boat from Entrance 2 to P2, enter the Upper Lakes waterfall group via official Line E, and walk for about 40–60 minutes.
从Entrance 2按E线或H线进入上湖区，抵达Labudovac及ST3观光: Enter the Upper Lakes area from Entrance 2 via Line E or Line H, and reach the open lakeshore trails near Labudovac and the ST3 tourist train station.
从Entrance 2进入，乘园区电动船至P2，游览Veliki Prštava: Enter from Entrance 2, take the park's electric boat to P2, explore the Veliki Prštavac, Galovački Buk, and Labudovac open trails, and return according to the operating schedule.
从Funchal机场乘可用航班前往亚速尔圣米格尔岛，必要时经里斯本中转，入住Po: Take an available flight from Funchal Airport to São Miguel Island in the Azores, transferring via Lisbon if necessary, and check in at Ponta Delgada.
从Funchal沿ER103山区道路及皮科里埃罗支路自驾约40–50分钟至山顶停: Drive from Funchal along the ER103 mountain road and the Pico do Arieiro branch road for about 40–50 minutes to the mountaintop parking area. PR1 extends from here towards Pedra Rija and Pico Ruivo.
从Funchal经VE4、ER110及ER209方向山区道路自驾约1–1.5小时: Drive from Funchal via the VE4, ER110, and ER209 mountain roads for about 1–1.5 hours to the parking area near Posto Florestal do Fanal, then walk 5–15 minutes.
从Funchal经VR1至Caniçal，再沿ER109进入圣洛伦索半岛，转入P: Drive from Funchal via the VR1 to Caniçal, then take the ER109 into the São Lourenço Peninsula, turn onto the Ponta do Rosto scenic road, park, and walk for a few minutes.
从Jardim do Morro地铁站沿修道院方向步行上坡约5–10分钟，抵达对: Walk uphill from Jardim do Morro metro station towards the monastery for about 5–10 minutes to reach the public open outer viewing area.
从Lagoa经N125及EM1273附近地方道路至Benagil海滩，预约合规持: From Lagoa, take local roads near the N125 and EM1273 to Benagil Beach, and book a kayak or motorized boat tour led by a compliant, licensed guide (usually about 1–2 hours).
从Lagos市区沿Estrada da Ponta da Piedade驾车约1: Drive from downtown Lagos along Estrada da Ponta da Piedade for about 10 minutes to the parking area near the lighthouse, then walk along the open wooden boardwalk; for boat tours, book a small boat from Lagos Marina.
从Lagos旧城向南步行约20–25分钟，或乘当地巴士至Dona Ana附近站点: Walk south from Lagos Old Town for about 20–25 minutes, or take the local bus to the stop near Dona Ana, then descend to the beach via public steps.
从Lagos沿Estrada da Ponta da Piedade前往O Ca: Drive from Lagos along Estrada da Ponta da Piedade toward the parking area near O Camilo, and walk down to the cove via about 200 wooden steps.
从Madrid Chamartín乘高速列车约25–35分钟至Segovia-G: Take the high-speed train from Madrid Chamartín to Segovia-Guiomar station (about 25–35 minutes), then take Bus Line 11 or a taxi (about 15–25 minutes) to Azoguejo Square.
从Madrid Puerta de Atocha乘Avant列车约30–35分钟: Take the Avant train from Madrid Puerta de Atocha to Toledo (about 30–35 minutes), then take a taxi (about 10–15 minutes) to the Carretera del Valle viewpoint.
从N125转入Praia da Marinha方向地方道路，在海滩公共停车区进入: Turn from the N125 onto local roads toward Praia da Marinha, enter the PR1 LGA Seven Hanging Valleys Trail from the beach public parking area, and walk along the open cliff-top trail for about 10–20 minutes to find the double-arch viewpoint.
从Peso da Régua沿N313及Galafura村镇道路自驾约30–40: Drive from Peso da Régua along the N313 and Galafura village roads for about 30–40 minutes, park, and walk to the public viewing area.
从Pile城门向西步行约10分钟，经西港旁石阶登上海堡。: Walk west from Pile Gate for about 10 minutes, and ascend to the fortress via the stone steps next to the West Harbour.
从Pile城门西侧下行至West Harbour，参加持证运营商组织的约2–3小: Descend from the west side of Pile Gate to West Harbour and join a 2–3 hour sea kayaking activity organized by licensed operators.
从Pile城门附近登上收费环城墙，沿规定单向游览线路行至北侧明切塔塔楼。: Access the paid city walls near Pile Gate, follow the designated one-way sightseeing route to the northern Minčeta Tower.
从Pinhão站沿N585-1及村镇道路自驾约15分钟，或沿PR20 ALJ步道: Drive from Pinhão station along the N585-1 and village roads for about 15 minutes, or hike uphill along the PR20 ALJ trail for about 1.5 hours.
从Plaza Larga沿阿尔拜辛上坡道路徒步约25–40分钟，亦可乘出租车至合: Walk uphill from Plaza Larga along the Albaicín slope for about 25–40 minutes, or take a taxi to the legal drop-off point and walk from there.
